HomePage.title: Hi, I'm Wojtek.
HomePage.description: This is the first small version of DevOnion - a personal place for my projects, ideas and experiments. I enjoy building full stack systems that help users with everyday tasks, remove unnecessary friction and make real workflows simpler and more intuitive. I care a lot about practical software: tools that are clear, reliable and genuinely useful instead of just technically interesting. Outside of coding, I like a good mix of activity and focus: hiking in the mountains, climbing, riding a bike, calisthenics, motorcycle rides and playing piano.
